definitions.exact: Original whitespace-collapse SHA256-equivalent text equality; original contents preserved.
definitions.words: Unicode NFKC, casefold, Unicode word tokens; audit only.
definitions.strict: Also exclude any literal consecutive 50 canonical words shared with old training. Includes boilerplate.
definitions.internal: One longest representative per connected component under the same overlap rules.
definitions.evaluation_length: 200 to 1500 canonical words; proposed target/control eligibility only.

limitations: Disjointness is relative to the prior fine-tuning corpus, not undocumented base pretraining.
Semantic paraphrases and shorter shared passages may remain; this is an explicit lexical audit.
Some candidates were earlier held-out diagnostic/evaluation articles, but were not optimizer training inputs.
Strict shared-passage filtering includes boilerplate and can conservatively reject unrelated stories.
